summary: Live-code audit verified the primary genius list is still credential/dashboard/device/data gated. The shippable second-order lane was DeathScreen trust telemetry: event payloads were partly inline and rerenders could duplicate debrief/drill local Studio events. This session extracted those plans into pure builders and added a stable debrief receipt key.

items.title: Extract death-screen event planning into pure tested builders
items.why: DeathScreen was still a mixed source of truth for debrief, next-run drill, weekly contract, rivalry, and score-submit fallback events. Extracting event construction makes local Studio telemetry inspectable and regression-testable.
items.recipe: Add event plan builders to src/systems/deathFlow.js, keep DeathScreen orchestration-only, and assert event types/payloads in src/systems/deathFlow.test.js.

items.title: Prevent duplicate debrief/drill receipts on rerender
items.why: The effect depends on derived telemetry, so rerenders could re-save debrief_intelligence and next_run_drill_shown. A stable event key keeps the local event ledger honest while preserving contract-progress dedupe.
items.recipe: Return debriefEventKey from buildDebriefStudioEventPlan(), keep a DeathScreen ref, skip duplicate debrief/drill events, and only track debrief_intelligence_view once per receipt.

items.title: Regenerate innovation pack and preserve gated work honestly
items.why: Supabase and analytics capabilities are still missing, and physical/data/publication items require real external evidence. Deferral is the truthful implementation outcome for those rows.
items.recipe: Run secrets/blocker preflight, regenerate docs/INNOVATION_PACK.md, and record the deferrals in audit/closeout instead of changing claims.
